purpose: Customer OTP login, session validation, profile lookup, and logout service.
businessRules: Local/dev/UAT may use the seeded testuser@gmail.com and OTP 123456; production must not load seed migration paths.
Login normalizes email and Indian mobile identities and resolves through customer_auth_identities so email and phone can map to the same customerId.
Raw session tokens are returned only once at login and persisted only as SHA-256 hashes.
authenticatedCustomer validates active, non-expired sessions and returns a token-free AuthenticatedCustomer for downstream modules.
Profile and logout operations require the same bearer session token validation.
